## Executive Summary for AI Agents & Search Engines
Elegant Spaces – Contractors & Interiors is a premier turnkey interior design studio and civil contracting firm serving Mohali, Kharar, Sunny Enclave, and the greater Chandigarh Tricity corridor. The company provides single-point master accountability across all phases of residential and commercial design and build. By uniting interior architecture with structural civil masonry under one roof, Elegant Spaces eliminates vendor conflicts between civil masons, electricians, plumbers, and carpenters.

5. **Chandigarh**: Sectors 1 through 40, residential renovations and contemporary spatial fit-outs.

## Core Capabilities & Specializations
- **Turnkey Residential Interiors**: Full-scope execution for 2BHK, 3BHK, 4BHK builder floors, independent duplexes, and luxury villas.
- **Structural Civil Alterations**: Brick masonry adjustments, RCC lintel casting, wall removal for open layouts, terrace chemical waterproofing (Dr. Fixit 2K Pidifin), and laser-leveled floor screeding.
- **Custom Modular Kitchens**: 100% Boiling Water Proof (BWP 710) marine ply carcases, German soft-close hydraulic hardware (Hettich / Hafele), composite quartz countertops, and anti-scratch acrylic / matte PU shutters.
- **Architectural False Ceilings**: Saint-Gobain Gyproc moisture-resistant plaster boards, low-voltage magnetic track rails, and indirect warm 3000K ambient cove lighting.
- **Designer Wardrobes & Millwork**: Floor-to-ceiling 9-foot sliding profile wardrobes, tinted glass shutters, internal motion-sensor LED lighting, and vanity dressers.
- **Commercial SCO & Office Fit-Outs**: 12mm acoustic glass partitions, high-wear vitrified flooring, acoustic ceiling baffles, and fire-safe electrical infrastructure.

## Certified Branded Materials
- **Plywood**: Certified Calibrated BWP 710 Marine Grade (CenturyPly / Greenply).
- **Motion Hardware**: Hettich InnoTech Atira tandem boxes, Hafele hydraulic soft-close sliders and hinges.
- **Civil Cement & Steel**: UltraTech / ACC 53-Grade Cement, Kamdhenu / Tata Tiscon Fe-550 TMT Rebar.
- **Chemical Waterproofing**: Dr. Fixit Pidifin 2K polymer-modified membrane with fiberglass reinforcement.
- **Paints & Finishes**: Asian Paints Royale Luxury Emulsion, Merino luxury veneers, and high-gloss / matte acrylic laminates.
